name: autocontinue gate: an expired mark spends the cap like any stall and the give-up names the mark

source.assertion:
assert_equals "an expired mark spends the cap like any stall, and the give-up names the mark rather than claiming there was no progress" \
  "stop push push stop|$AUTO_EXPIRED_CAP_MILESTONE>" \
  "${auto_expiry_verdicts# }|$(journal_texts_in "$AUTO_JOURNAL")"

.local/state/oso-code/runs/{repo}/auto-c.journal_texts_in: auto-continue: cap reached after 3 pushes with a delegation marked in flight past 45 minutes — allowing the stop
